name: apex-psi
title: APEX PSI
description: Cryptographic open-standard evidence protocol for AI governance. Seal decisions to an append-only ledger, verify SHA-256 hashes, check Bitcoin anchoring status, browse ledger attestations, and read the protocol reference.

tools.name: seal
tools.title: Seal a decision to the APEX PSI ledger
tools.description: Mint a post-quantum verifiable receipt for a machine action or decision. Canonicalises the payload, signs it (SHA-256 + Ed25519 + LMS-W4-SHA256), records it in the append-only ledger, and returns a receipt id that any agent can later re-check with verify_hash.

decision.description: The action or decision text to seal — what the machine did.

model_id.description: Optional identifier of the model or agent that produced the decision.

context.description: Optional description of the decision environment.

predicate.description: Optional predicate id, e.g. EU_ART_50. Defaults to EU_ART_12.

tools.name: verify_hash
tools.title: Verify a hash against the APEX PSI ledger
tools.description: Look up a SHA-256 hash (commit hash or Merkle leaf hash) in the APEX PSI evidence ledger and report whether a matching attestation exists.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash to verify, lowercase hex.

tools.name: anchor_status
tools.title: Bitcoin anchoring status of a sealed receipt
tools.description: Report the OpenTimestamps / Bitcoin anchoring state for a sealed receipt: whether its Merkle root has been committed to a real Bitcoin block, the block height, the transaction id and the offline `ots verify` command.

commit_id.description: Receipt id returned by `seal`, e.g. APEX-NTR-....

tools.name: list_attestations
tools.title: List recent attestations
tools.description: List the most recent APEX PSI ledger attestations visible to the signed-in user, newest first.

tools.name: ledger_stats
tools.title: APEX PSI ledger statistics
tools.description: Return counts of ledger attestations, non-approved exceptions and public attestations for a quick integrity snapshot.

tools.name: protocol_info
tools.title: APEX PSI protocol reference
tools.description: Return the APEX PSI protocol reference: canonicalization, hashing, signature suites, IETF drafts, HTTP header and anchoring targets.

section.description: Which part of the reference to return.
